label: Every being contingent at w is in POTENCY_1 or has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (B2 or B4), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate contingent at w is either in POTENCY_1 in at least one (any) respect or has some other being that causes its esse (CAUSE_2 at esse). Each of B2 and B4 implies it (controls, laws 4-5), so it is the weakest of the three as typed. It is not the q.9 a.2 pair of channels (mutable in the subject, MUTABLE_1; mutable through another's power, MUTABLE_2): reading it as exhausting those channels would need two unrecorded OPEN bridges, contingency at w gives mutability in some way (MUTABLE_3), and another's power over a thing's esse gives a distinct cause of its esse. A brute contingent being, neither in potency nor caused, falsifies it (controls, model 1).
